# Mohan Kumar Indala | Portfolio
> Full Stack Developer specializing in React, Next.js, Express, and SQL. Building modern web applications with clean architecture and great UX.

## Pages
- [Home](https://indala.vercel.app/): Portfolio homepage with hero and featured sections
- [About](https://indala.vercel.app/about): Background, skills, and journey as a developer
- [Projects](https://indala.vercel.app/projects): Showcase of web applications and tools built
- [Contact](https://indala.vercel.app/contact): Contact form and social links

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Nest.js
- Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase
- Tools: Git, Socket.io, Leaflet Maps
